clips.text: Your turn. Give Pixel Reel anything wordy, and it comes back as a pixel reel, read out by me.
It can be a link to an article. A letter you've been sent. Or just a question, like, how does a mortgage work.
On the make page there is one big box. Copy a link, press Paste, and in it goes. Or type a question. Or, for a letter, take a photo of it.
Then press Make my reel. Claude writes the scenes, I read them out, and it plays as soon as it is ready.
Still too much to take in? Ask for it simpler, or shorter. And your reels are listed on the make page, to watch again, or to delete.
